#/texts/6.label: paragraph
#/texts/6.full_gt_text: The undersigned is directed to say that w.e.f. the afternoon of the 8th June, 1980:-

#/texts/7.label: paragraph
#/texts/7.full_gt_text: (i) Shri V.C. Shukla assumed the office of the Minister of Civil Supplies;

#/texts/8.label: paragraph
#/texts/8.full_gt_text: (ii) Shri N.D. Tewari assumed the office of the Minister of Planning;

#/texts/9.label: paragraph
#/texts/9.full_gt_text: (iii) Shri Kedar Pande assumed the office of the Minister of Irrigation;

#/texts/10.label: paragraph
#/texts/10.full_gt_text: (iv) Shri Dalbir Singh assumed the office of the Minister of State in the Ministry of Petroleum & Chemicals;

#/texts/11.label: paragraph
#/texts/11.full_gt_text: (v) Shri T. Arjiah assumed the office of the Minister of State in the Ministry of Labour;

#/texts/12.label: paragraph
#/texts/12.full_gt_text: (vi) Shri Buta Singh assumed the office of the Minister of State in the Ministry of Shipping & Transport;

#/texts/13.label: paragraph
#/texts/13.full_gt_text: (vii) Shri Chandulal Chandrakar assumed the office of the Minister of State in the Ministry of Tourism & Civil Aviation;

#/texts/14.label: paragraph
#/texts/14.full_gt_text: (viii) Shri Vikram Mahajan assumed the office of the Minister of State in the Ministry of Energy;

#/texts/15.label: paragraph
#/texts/15.full_gt_text: (ix) Smt. Ram Dulari Sinha assumed the office of the Minister of State in the Ministry of Information & Broadcasting;

#/texts/16.label: paragraph
#/texts/16.full_gt_text: (x) Shri Mallikarjun assumed the office of the Deputy Minister in the Ministry of Railways;

#/texts/17.label: paragraph
#/texts/17.full_gt_text: (xi) Shri P. Venkata Reddy assumed the office of the Deputy Minister in the Ministry of Industry;

#/texts/18.label: paragraph
#/texts/18.full_gt_text: (xii) Shri Mohammad Usman Arif assumed the office of the Deputy Minister in the Ministry of Works & Housing;

#/texts/19.label: paragraph
#/texts/19.full_gt_text: (xiii) Shri Maganbhai Barot assumed the office of the Deputy Minister in the Ministry of Finance;

#/texts/20.label: paragraph
#/texts/20.full_gt_text: (xiv) Shri Vijay N. Patil assumed the office of the Deputy Minister in the Departments of Science & Technology and Space; and
